name: Uncertainty Sample
description: Selects experimental conditions where the model exhibits the highest uncertainty in its predictions, enabling active learning strategies.

parameters.name: conditions
parameters.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions to evaluate for model uncertainty.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Scikit-learn compatible model with a predict_proba method for uncertainty estimation.

parameters.name: num_samples
parameters.description: Number of high-uncertainty samples to select.

parameters.name: measure
parameters.description: Uncertainty evaluation method: least_confident (1 - max probability), margin (difference between top two probabilities), or entropy (Shannon entropy).

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: DataFrame or array of candidate experimental conditions.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: DataFrame of selected high-uncertainty experimental conditions.
